submission.bindingBasis: Workspace state has changed since planning: new committed .hp4-probe/material.txt represents concurrent work not present in reviewed planning state. The planning binding attempt failed with REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed. Need to reobserve to understand whether the workspace is now ready to close or whether there is additional local materialization to release.
submission.rationale: Planning evidence described a clean workspace ready to close, but consequence boundary evidence shows a new committed .hp4-probe/material.txt exists that was not present in the reviewed planning state. The planning binding attempt failed (REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed) because the head revision and source state digest differ from what was planned against. The intended consequence is to close the workspace, but the workspace has changed with concurrent work. Reobserving is required to determine the current state and whether the workspace can be closed, and to decide the correct binding (if any) to use. Acting unbound or replaying exactly against stale evidence would be unsafe; holding without progress is not ideal but reobservation is the correct intermediate step.
